title: HVAC and Plumbing in Elmendorf, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing and Air offers services for HVAC and plumbing in Elmendorf, TX and the surrounding areas. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: Your home has multiple systems that require professional care. Among these, its heating and cooling systems and water infrastructure are especially critical. The good news is that you can turn to Rosenberg Plumbing & Air for comprehensive HVAC services in Elmendorf, TX.

We’re also the area’s leading plumbing service provider. So, whether you need a new AC or help with a clogged drain, we’ll be there to help you. Whatever home comfort needs you have, we can help! Contact us today.
Keeping your heating and cooling systems running efficiently and reliably requires regular maintenance. Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is the top local provider of comfort system maintenance services.

Our technicians can handle annual maintenance for ACs, furnaces, heat pumps, and mini-splits. We can protect your comfort investment and keep your heating and cooling costs low. And we offer a convenient Comfort Club membership to make meeting your maintenance needs easy.

We also recognize that there will be times when your AC or heater needs repair. If you spot the signs of trouble early, you can often minimize repair costs. Look for energy bill spikes and changes in your home’s air quality. Those can signal a malfunction in your heating and cooling equipment. Our technicians repair all makes and models of HVACs. We carry common parts to perform repairs as quickly as possible.

When repairs aren’t a suitable option, we can offer an HVAC replacement instead. We sell and install high-quality systems from reputable manufacturers, such as Lennox. Additionally, our NATE-certified technicians have extensive experience in system installation. Our team will make your system replacement as quick and convenient as possible. Plus, we offer financing on approved credit for these upgrades that don’t fit into your immediate budget.

Your home’s water infrastructure is a complex yet robust system. That helps keep it reliable for years with very little maintenance. However, common problems can still affect your home’s pipes and fixtures. By far, the most common issue is a clogged drain. It happens as various combinations of substances entering your drains coalesce into restrictions. When your drains are running slowly or backing up, you must take prompt action. We can investigate the clog using a remote camera inspection. That lets our plumbers know the exact location and composition of your clog. Using that information, we can clean your drain using the most appropriate method.

Leaks are another issue that you don’t want to ignore. Most pipes inside your home run through places you can’t see. Our plumbers can help you locate hidden leaks and provide solutions, such as pipe patching and repiping, to eliminate them.

We also offer water heater services to ensure you always have a reliable supply of hot water. That includes installing and repairing tankless water heaters. A tankless heater provides on-demand hot water and can last longer than conventional storage-tank heaters.
For expert plumbing and HVAC services in Elmendorf, contact Rosenberg Plumbing & Air today!
